name: Table Rollup
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Keeps table columns when repeated headers match a written suffix.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Repeated headers that differ by a written suffix now keep separate columns.
Currency amounts with Unicode symbols are read correctly.
tip: Click a column header twice to sort the rows in the other direction.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Table Rollup is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your tables.
